description: This file defines the ContentWrapper interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.content.content package, providing static utility methods for handling content-related operations such as retrieving default MIME types, extracting field values from model objects, encoding content, and querying content entities.

classes.name: ContentWrapper
classes.description: An interface defining content retrieval and utility methods relevant to content management in OFBiz.

methods.name: getDefaultMimeTypeId
methods.description: Returns the default MIME type ID from properties, with a fallback to 'text/html; charset=utf-8'.

methods.name: getCandidateFieldValue (GenericValue, String)
methods.description: Checks if the modelObject has a field named after the given contentTypeId and returns its value if present.

methods.name: getCandidateFieldValue (Delegator, String, EntityCondition, String, boolean)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific candidate field value from the model entity identified by modelEntityName and primary key, with optional caching.

methods.name: encodeContentValue
methods.description: Encodes the given content string using the specified encoderType, sanitizing it accordingly.
